description: Create a new Jobsite workspace that holds only sample data (a sample crew, jobs and safety records; nothing real) for the person you are helping, so they can try Jobsite without setting anything up. Returns a one-time claim link to give them: opening it lets them create their login (or sign in) and own the workspace. The link expires in 7 days, and an unclaimed workspace is then deleted. Exploring the sample data is free; adding real workers needs a Jobsite plan. Takes no personal details. Limited to 3 workspaces a day per network address. Optional: company_name, focus (safety or home services) and the company's trade.

company_name.description: The company name for the workspace (default "Sample Company"). The person can change it later.

focus.description: safety (default): the Safety Suite. home_services: the Home Services Suite (service calls, estimates).

trade.description: The company's trade in a few words, e.g. "roofing" or "HVAC"; it sets the workspace's industry when it matches one Jobsite lists.

name: start_jobsite_workspace
title: Start a sample Jobsite workspace
